paragraphs: Abba Mar, son of Rav Pappa. Rav Pappa and another person interrupted for him, although two do not interrupt for one while eating (chapter Sheloshah She'akhalu, 45b). Rav Pappa said, “For someone such as Abba Mar my son, I would impair a document’s standing on his testimony” (Ketubbot 85a). Rav Pappa at the wedding of Abba Mar his son (Kiddushin 32, beginning of b; see below, Yitzchak, Rav Pappa’s student). He married Abba of Sura’s daughter (see below, Rav Pappa).
